mapper.insert: MERGE INTO wo_user_sheet_view T USING (SELECT CAST(#{userKey} AS VARCHAR) AS USER_KEY, CAST(#{workbookSeq} AS BIGINT) AS WORKBOOK_SEQ, CAST(#{sheetSeq} AS BIGINT) AS SHEET_SEQ) S ON (T.USER_KEY = S.USER_KEY AND T.WORKBOOK_SEQ = S.WORKBOOK_SEQ AND T.SHEET_SEQ = S.SHEET_SEQ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET ZOOM_RATIO = COALESCE(CAST(#{zoomRatio} AS DECIMAL(4,2)), T.ZOOM_RATIO), SEEN_DATETIME = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( USER_KEY, WORKBOOK_SEQ, SHEET_SEQ, ZOOM_RATIO, SEEN_DATETIME ) VALUES ( #{userKey}, #{workbookSeq}, #{sheetSeq}, COALESCE(CAST(#{zoomRatio} AS DECIMAL(4,2)), 1.0), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )

INSERT INTO wo_user_sheet_view ( USER_KEY, WORKBOOK_SEQ, SHEET_SEQ, ZOOM_RATIO, SEEN_DATETIME ) VALUES ( #{userKey}, #{workbookSeq}, #{sheetSeq}, COALESCE(CAST(#{zoomRatio} AS DECIMAL(4,2)), 1.0), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON CONFLICT (USER_KEY, WORKBOOK_SEQ, SHEET_SEQ) DO UPDATE SET ZOOM_RATIO = COALESCE(CAST(#{zoomRatio} AS DECIMAL(4,2)), wo_user_sheet_view.ZOOM_RATIO), SEEN_DATETIME = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
